newsitem.title: USA: U. of Michigan consumer sentiment Feb final 99.7.
newsitem.headline: U. of Michigan consumer sentiment Feb final 99.7.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for February rose to 99.7 compared with 97.4 in the final January index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 107.2 in the final February report against the 106.8 reading in the final January.
The expectations index rose to 94.9 in the February final data versus 91.3 in the final January, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
